_about: Dumas's two most-assigned romances, in the anonymous translations Gutenberg carries (Monte Cristo: Chapman and Hall, 1846; The Man in the Iron Mask: the 19th-century English version of the last part of Le Vicomte de Bragelonne). Translators unnamed in the files; both translations are 19th-century and so US public domain. Added in reading-lists batch 9 (2026-10-17): books named by the Omnibus, Callihan, Kern, Pudewa, White and Stanford lists that no shelf held.

dumas-count-of-monte-cristo: The Count of Monte Cristo (1844-46; anonymous English translation, 1846)
dumas-man-in-the-iron-mask: The Man in the Iron Mask (1847-50; anonymous 19th-century English translation)
